title: Implementation Challenges in NeVA
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs

Implementation Challenges in NeVA

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
05 AUG 2026 3:52PM by PIB Delhi

Implementation of the National e-Vidhan Application (NeVA) involved the development of a generic application capable of catering to the diverse rules of procedure, practices and business processes followed across State/UT Legislatures, while addressing variations in the ICT infrastructure, baseline digitalisation, digital capacity and adoption of paperless legislative processes by stakeholders. These aspects were addressed through incorporation of suitable configurations in the application, financial assistance for procuring ICT infrastructure and technical manpower, capacity-building and orientation programmes, handholding support, and continuous coordination with the concerned State/UT Legislatures.

This information was given by the Minister of State (Independent Charge) of Law and Justice and Minister of State of Parliamentary Affairs, Shri Arjun Ram Meghwal in a written reply in Lok Sabha today.
